title: VTCParticipant.displayName drifts from ChatContact mid-call
description: VTC spec line 290: displayName derived from ChatContact/user profile. But ChatContact.displayName and SpaceMember.nick (Chat line 680) can change mid-call. No resync rule defined. VTCParticipantEvent snapshots displayName at event time. Clients see different names in call UI vs chat UI for same user.
